reference_version: 8.0.1 plus an unpinned redis-benchmark RDMA fork

published-as-written.interpretation: Confounded reference reproduction: different key ranges and hit fractions; RDB snapshots remain enabled despite AOF being off. Not a transport-only comparison.

matched-ram.interpretation: Matched RAM transport control: sequential full-keyspace prefill; same keys, clients and client implementation; no AOF or RDB persistence. Not a durable-write comparison.

limits: PING/SET/GET subset only; the reference LRANGE_100 and its LPUSH preparation are not KV operations and are not included.
Use separate freshly started standalone servers with identical dual-listener configuration for each transport; no cluster sharding.
The current pinned upstream client replaces the historical unpinned fork. Hardware, version, affinity and NIC differences remain explicit.
Native benchmark stdout contains latency histograms, not every operation's raw API/scheduling timings; this does not replace the durable research suite.
The local qualifier is TCP-only, uses smaller explicitly labeled counts, and makes no remote RDMA performance claim.
